Subject: Initial request: DPF evidence + DPA annex mapping for Clinexis evaluation

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — Clinexis is progressing through procurement and the privacy team asked for a compact evidence pack to validate Redwood against the EU-US Data Protection Framework and the DPA Annex items.

What would be helpful at this stage: a brief index of artifacts we can review (privacy policy excerpts, SCC/DPF mapping, operational controls, key management details, and a sample of audit logs showing retention/erasure workflows). We prefer documents that are consumable by our legal and info-sec reviewers; a single-sheet mapping of DPA Annex clauses to Redwood controls would be ideal.

Timeline: can you deliver a preliminary pack by end-of-week (Friday)? Appreciate if you can also confirm whether Redwood supports DPF attestations for uploads originating in the EU and whether there are any service limitations in the Healthcare SaaS tier.

Best,
Elena Soto
Senior Privacy Manager
Clinexis Health

Hi Elena — thanks for outlining the ask. We're happy to put a concise evidence pack together. High level answers up front:

- Redwood provides DPF-aligned transfers for customer data when configured to EU-only regions or via our Private deployment options; our hosted API offers contractual safeguards and operational measures that align to DPF principles.
- There are no functional limitations in the Healthcare tier for the controls you asked about; some features (e.g., customer-managed HSM) are part of our Enterprise private deployment add-on.

Plan:
1) I'll deliver an index PDF + DPA Annex mapping spreadsheet by EOD Friday (attached will include control references and where evidence lives).
2) Ben (cc'd) will also attach a sample audit log export and note retention/erasure process.
3) If you need legal language for the DPA Annex, Marissa in Legal can provide the standard clause text and any redline guidance.

Deliverables we will attach: redwood_dpf_evidence_index_v1.2.pdf, dpa_annex_mapping_clinexis.xlsx, and a sample audit log CSV. Let me know if you need DocuSign links or a dedicated walkthrough for your security reviewers.

Best,
Rachel Kim

Subject: Fw: sample audit log and retention notes for Clinexis (internal / redacted)

Hi Elena,

Per Rachel's note, attaching a redacted audit sample and short explanation of how event retention and subject-access requests are handled.

Key points:
- Audit logs are partitioned by tenant and timestamped in UTC; export includes event_type, model_id, request_id, user_principal (redacted), and action.
- Retention is configurable per-customer: default 90 days on hosted tier, configurable up to 7 years for Dedicated/Private.
- Erasure flow: we create a deletion job which removes non-essential derivatives (prefix caches, logs) and triggers a verification report; persistent customer artifacts stored under their VPC are removed per the DPA.

I've attached sample_audit_log_redwood_2026-08.csv (rows redacted for privacy) and a short explainer. If you want a full schema for the logs, we can schedule a quick technical call.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Security Architect
Redwood Inference

2) For the sample audit log: can you include an example event that shows an erasure job completed with verification (timestamp + job id)? Our team needs to validate the verification artifact format.
3) Are there metrics/dashboard extracts available showing token-level processing locality (i.e., region where inference executed) per request? We want to confirm no unintended EU egress.

If possible, we'd like the updated mapping and the erasure example by Tuesday so our legal can draft the DPA redlines.

Elena
